parts:
We're going to be down at

Untamed Sandwiches
43 W 39th St
6 - 9 pm

They have good food, beer, and wine.

I figure some of us can punt work early and head down. Any opposition?

Andrew, it's a place where all the Pooks can go. If you wanted to go even earlier, that's cool too.

Daniel
